principles.title: One system of action
principles.text: Archiving, firm compliance, employee compliance, and marketing review belong in one system, where the work and the record of the work live together.

principles.title: Automation everywhere
principles.text: AI-native automation built into every workflow rather than a chatbot layered on old tools. It drafts, triages, and routes so your people decide.

principles.title: Software your team will love
principles.text: Every workflow is built to reduce friction for the people outside compliance, because a culture of compliance only happens when the tool actually gets used.

principles.title: Exam-ready by default
principles.text: Unified recordkeeping designed for CCO peace of mind, so an exam request becomes a query instead of a fire drill.

principles.title: Privacy worth trusting
principles.text: Protect the firm’s critical data with smarter supervision methods that build trust with your people instead of eroding it.

principles.title: Fiduciary care
principles.lead: A pact with our users, not just a promise.
principles.text: Greenboard holds a strong fiduciary pact toward the betterment of our users, with governance mechanisms in place to ensure that responsibility continues no matter how the company grows.

tiers.name: Small firms
tiers.title: A full program without a full team.
tiers.text: One person often carries the whole program. Greenboard gives them the archive, the calendar, the attestations, and the exam file in one place, with Go handling the busywork.

tiers.name: Growing businesses
tiers.title: Scale the program, not the headcount.
tiers.text: As headcount and channels multiply, supervision has to keep pace. Configure your own risk graph, route work to the right reviewers, and keep everything on one record.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.title: Built for layered supervisory structures.
tiers.text: Multi-entity firms, complex hierarchies, and heavy recordkeeping obligations, served on WORM-based, 17a-4 compliant infrastructure with SOC 2 Type 2 controls.
